title: Kia Kio and Tree of Life
statement: Every binary tree whose in-order traversal is the array (a Catalan number of them, built by recursively choosing a root) is scored by cutting each edge and adding the XORs of the two resulting parts. The task is to sum these scores over all such trees modulo 998244353. With n up to 2·10^5 and a_i < 2^18, quadratic segment enumeration is too slow, calling for per-bit convolution.
